time_basis: UTC, to the second. Commit times are git committer times (git log --format=%cI) converted to UTC. Log times are the first field of results/oos_peeks.log, results/tracking/test_peeks.log and results/tt/peeks.log, converted to UTC. time_source says where an event's utc comes from: log (its earliest own log line), commit, mtime (local file modification times quoted in a committed document or read on the authors' machine), document (a time stated in a committed document). utc is the start of the event; utc_end, when present, its last log line or last known action.

kinds.a: pre-registered single evaluation: the rule was frozen in prereg_commit before the read. data_state says whether the data were clean or had been read before.
kinds.b: reproduction of an already-reported number; no decision and no new statistic
kinds.c: replay, diagnostic, sensitivity or descriptive read; no rule chosen (may add new statistics)
kinds.d: design, selection or headline decision taken after an OOS (or held-out) look
kinds.e: defect fix adopted after an OOS look; direction = its effect on the reported number
kinds.f: blind or post-freeze evaluation on data that no analysis of this rule had used (new universe, new market type, newer matches); prereg_commit froze the rule before the read
kinds.protocol: change to a pre-registered protocol that read no data

kind_labels.d: design/headline choice after an OOS look
kind_labels.e: defect fix after an OOS look

data_states.clean: never read by any analysis before this event
data_states.burned: machine code, never printed: U1 OOS (match start >= 2026-08-25 14:15 UTC) after its first evaluation at 2026-10-03 10:42:28Z
data_states.untouched: no strategy had been computed on these data and the rule was frozen before their first read (U2 before 17:31:29Z, OOS side-market tapes, newer matches)
data_states.partly_read: new for this rule, but the same data (or raw books of some of its matches) had been read earlier for another purpose before the rule was frozen
data_states.forward: live recordings of 2026-10-03 (data/live, data/live_v2, data/live_maker); the 9 replay matches also built the CV model's measured inputs
data_states.test_used: a held-out set after its single evaluation (tracking test_1..7, U2, OOS side markets, table-tennis OOS, the fresh window)

label_rules: Labels are derived by scripts/provenance.py derive_label in this order; label codes are not printed (label_text is).
in-sample: the result's period is IS (flags say whether its rule was shaped by OOS looks)
not-run: none of the result's events read data (only protocol or d events)
blind: the result has a kind f event, every f event read untouched data, and its prereg_commit precedes the read
post-freeze: the result has a kind f event that read partly_read data or whose pre-registration was committed after the read
clean-oos: a kind a event read clean data and no kind d or e event touches the result
burned-non-blind (printed as 'non-blind'): any OOS-informed d or e event touches the result, or any of its events read burned or test_used data
exploratory: everything else (no pre-registered P&L test; forward recordings only)

Required flags, checked: oos_selected (a d or e event picked the reported variant after seeing its OOS value), oos_informed_design (a d event after an OOS look), defect_fix_after_oos (an e event after an OOS look), prereg_committed_after_run (an a or f event whose pre-registration was committed after the read)

result_kinds.executable: trades we could have placed at our own latency, priced from the book we would have hit
result_kinds.sim_upper_bound: simulated fills with an optimistic fill rule
result_kinds.others_fills: fills that other (faster) traders obtained, re-timed causally
result_kinds.conditional: trade set conditional on realised outcomes (for example realised >= 4c jumps); not tradable as stated
result_kinds.event_study: ex-post study of what fast traders earned around events, or a shadow book built from their fills; not attainable copier profit
result_kinds.descriptive: a measurement that is not a trading result (classifier precision, a status)
result_kinds.diagnostic: a check that supports another result
